title: Capacity Hub — scaling operation playbook, throughput telemetry, and immutable change timeline
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description: Build a centralized 'Capacity Hub' inside Redwood Console that gives operators a single place to: (1) configure and preview autoscaling and throughput guarantee policies for dedicated fleets; (2) inspect realtime and historical throughput/latency telemetry with percentile breakdowns and request shape filters; and (3) review an append-only, immutable change timeline (who changed what, diffs, and optional operator notes) with first-class rollback and emergency freeze actions. The goal is to reduce on-call toil for Dedicated customers by making scaling decisions observable and reversible, and to provide clear evidence for SLA/commitment conversations. This ticket covers the product requirements, acceptance criteria, and close collaboration with design and ENG to land the UI flows, API contracts, and audit persistence model.
acceptance_criteria: Capacity Hub landing page shows all fleets with current scaling policy, current throughput headroom, and a one-click 'Inspect' that opens fleet detail
Fleet detail page includes realtime throughput chart (1m/5m/1h), p50/p90/p99 latency series, and a filterable request-shape heatmap for the last 72 hours
Operators can create/update scaling policies (min/max instances, target RPS or target p95 latency, cooldowns) via a modal with validation and a preview of expected capacity/cost impact

All scaling-policy changes are recorded to an immutable change timeline with user, ISO timestamp, config diff, optional operator note, and a 'Revert' action that re-applies the previous policy as a new timeline entry

Integrations: change timeline entries include links to the rollout job and show resulting capacity events from the runtime (success/failure), and policy updates trigger telemetry ingestion to the throughput dashboards within 5 minutes

QA: End-to-end tests covering policy creation, policy revert, dashboard filtering, and timeline immutability; performance budget validated for page load under 2s for fleets with up to 10k metric series
